verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly requires a manuscript chapter containing questions for people entering leadership roles for the first time.
The client establishes a flexible 2,500-to-3,500-word content guideline for each planned chapter, an implementation-relevant manuscript acceptance condition.

The client classifies the first-time-leader chapter as question-and-answer content with a flexible question count governed by the overall book limit, superseding its prior chapter-level word guidance.
